name: UHV and HV substations (275-500 kV)
principle: The 275 kV and 500 kV bulk nodes of the Malaysian grid. Air-insulated switchyard designs (dead-tank breakers, disconnectors, CTs and VTs, surge arresters, lattice busbars) dominate on land, with gas-insulated switchgear for space-constrained urban sites. Transformer banks step 500/275 kV and 275/132 kV; shunt reactors and capacitor banks or SVC/STATCOM manage voltage on long lines; IEC 61850 substation automation runs protection and monitoring.

process_steps.name: Busbars and transfer schemes (AIS or GIS)
